The free Playbook

The Past Prospect Playbook

A step-by-step guide to finding the meetings that already exist in your CRM. One 7-day sequence you can run yourself, without buying a single new lead.

  1. Who goes on the list, who stays off it, and how many names to start with.

  2. What goes out each day, and why.

  3. Six emails, the short notes that go with them, and call and voicemail scripts.

  4. A reply for each common answer, including “later” and “stop”.

  5. How to confirm the meeting, remind them, and run it.

  6. A tracker for the window, plus a checklist and a note to send your compliance team.

How to get it: enter your work email and we’ll send it, whether we’re a fit or not.

How it works when we run it

Three steps. Built, launched, then tuned every week.

  1. Step 1 · Weeks 1 to 2

    Build

    We build your list of ideal clients and clean up your CRM. We write the messages, and your compliance team approves every one before anything is sent.

  2. Step 2 · Weeks 3 to 4

    Launch

    We contact the people already in your CRM first. New prospects start getting messages the same week. A real person answers every reply and books the first meetings onto your calendar.

  3. Step 3 · Every week after

    Grow

    Every Monday you get one simple report: messages sent, replies, meetings booked, meetings attended, and what each meeting cost. If a number is off, we fix the list, the messages, or the volume.

What makes this different

  • Your CRM first.

    We start with the past prospects you already met, then reach new people.

  • Your compliance team approves every outreach message.

    No outreach goes out until they sign off.

  • A flat fee.

    No per-meeting fees, so we are not paid more for booking more. No share of your fees, and nothing based on assets.

  • Booked for your firm only.

    Nothing is shared with another advisor.

  • You own everything.

    Domains, inboxes, copy, templates and data stay with your firm.

  • Done for you.

    No ad spend. No filming. No software to learn.

Our 90-day commitment

At least 15 attended, qualified meetings in your first 90 days from launch.

In your first 90 days from launch, we commit to at least 15 attended, qualified meetings that match your written criteria. If we’re short, we keep working at our cost (no operating fee) until you’ve taken 15 such meetings.

Written into your services agreement

Conditions, so it stays fair on both sides

  • Agree on your ideal client and the messages at kickoff
  • One advisor or owner on the weekly call
  • Follow the process we set for booked meetings

A qualified meeting is with a prospect who fits your written asset minimum, niche and geography, is a decision maker or co-decision maker, and attends live. You set the criteria in advance. The 90 days start at launch, so compliance review time does not count against them.

Questions

Is the Playbook really free?

Yes. Enter your work email and we send it. You don’t have to book a call.

What happens after I enter my email?

A 60-second fit check: five questions and your contact details. Then you can pick a time for a 20-minute call on Google Meet. It ends with a yes or a no. Either way, you get the Playbook.

Do you sell leads?

No. We book attended first meetings for your firm only. Nothing is shared with another advisor.

How does compliance work?

Your compliance team approves every outreach message before it is sent. Outreach is by email and LinkedIn only, from domains and inboxes in your firm’s name that your firm owns. We keep a reply log your compliance team can access. Questions about investments, performance, or fees go to your advisor. The compliance decision stays with your firm.

What counts as a qualified meeting?

A prospect who fits your written asset minimum, niche and geography, is a decision maker or co-decision maker, and attends live.

What does it cost?

A flat fee with no per-meeting fees. We go through it on the fit call.

How fast does it start?

We plan to launch within 30 days of kickoff, starting with your past prospects. The 90 days start at launch.

Do you promise new clients?

No. We commit to attended, qualified meetings. Closing them is yours.

Do you have RIA case studies?

Not yet. Advisor Booking is new to RIAs, and we have no RIA clients yet. That is why the commitment is written into your agreement.
